text: Over the summer my office was involved in trying to remedy a situation that had arisen at a property on Ravina Crescent. The previous owners had constructed a raised flower bed, not obstructing the sidewalk or driveway, yet the flower bed technically covered a small part of the City's Right of Way. After reviewing the matter I believe that conducting enforcement in this instance would be a disproportionate response and ignores that thousands of residents have raised flower beds or other front garden elements that could be subject to enforcement.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services, to waive the 0.5m setback requirement at 23 Ravina Crescent and enter into any agreement with the homeowner as required.
